entries.title: Find which RTA holds your HDFC Mutual Fund folio
steps: HDFC Mutual Fund folios are serviced by CAMS as the registrar and transfer agent, so most HDFC Mutual Fund investors use the CAMS portal.
If your folio was opened with another AMC and later transferred to HDFC Mutual Fund, it may sit with KFintech instead.
Check your folio number on your latest statement or account maintenance form to see which RTA holds it, then use that RTA's portal.

entries.title: Download a consolidated account statement (CAS)
steps: Log in to your RTA's investor portal with your folio number and credentials; CAMS uses a mobile number or email plus PAN, and KFintech uses a similar login.
Open the statements or My Account section and choose Consolidated Account Statement.
Select the financial year or date range, and the folios to include if you have more than one.
Download the statement as a PDF and save it. Consolidated statements can be large, so request one year at a time.

entries.title: Download a capital-gains statement
steps: Log in to your RTA's investor portal and go to the reports or tax section.
Choose Capital Gains Statement, then select the financial year in which the units were sold.
Pick the file format you need: a readable PDF, an Excel or CSV for your own records, or the ITR-ready XML/XML schema file your tax preparer may ask for.
Download and keep the file with your tax records, since the same details are needed at income-tax filing time.

entries.title: Download the annual tax summary for income-tax filing
steps: Log in to your RTA's investor portal and open the tax or tax reports section.
Request the annual tax statement for the relevant financial year; it lists dividend income and realised capital gains per scheme.
Download the file, then use it to cross-check the figures in your income-tax return before you file.
Note that mutual fund tax rules changed for units bought on or after 1 April 2023, so check the holding period shown for each transaction rather than assuming an older rule.

entries.title: Where to find official fund documents and investor education
steps: AMFI's Investor Corner is the industry body one-stop hub for mutual fund knowledge, scheme categorisation and risk-o-meter explainers.
For scheme-specific charges, investment objective and risk details, read the official HDFC Mutual Fund SID, KIM and monthly factsheet for that scheme.
Keep the factsheet: it is the official monthly document that carries a scheme's expense ratio, benchmark and portfolio disclosures.
